context_for_next_agent:
WHAT CHANGED (user-facing)
Seven handoff docs in .agents/ were still describing the RETIRED v1 protocol. They told any
incoming agent to (a) hand-edit TASK_LOG.md / SESSION_INDEX.md, (b) "APPEND your task entry",
(c) keep updating .agents/state/task.md every 30 min, and (d) hand-create "5 mandatory
artifacts". In the v2 system TASK_LOG.md + SESSION_INDEX.md are GENERATED (hand-edits are
silently overwritten) and no task.md exists. An agent following the old docs would lose work
and/or write to a file nothing reads. All 7 docs now match .agents/workflows/handoff-to-any.md.
Commit: 4ee758f (branch chore/retire-v1-handoff-docs), 7 files, +162/-154.

FILES TOUCHED
  .agents/QUICK_START_CARD.md            (ENDING WORK -> handoff-new.cjs one-liner; task.md dropped; platform codes)
  .agents/workflows/start-here.md        (Step 13 rewritten; task.md progress updates removed; retired-artifact note)
  .agents/workflows/pickup-from-any.md   (checklist / Task Numbering / Quick Stats / Rule)
  .agents/state/README.md                (v1.0 -> v2.0; task.md marked retired; fast path; platform codes)
  .agents/AGENT_ONBOARDING_GUIDE.md      (maintenance table; Path D; TASK_LOG section)
  .agents/INDEX.md                       (file-structure tree; Task Log description)
  .agents/PROJECT_STATUS.md              (Current Task -> latest checkpoint)

HOW THE v2 WORKFLOW ACTUALLY WORKS (verified against source this session)
  node .agents/scripts/handoff-new.cjs <platform> "<work summary>" [--model M --provider P] ["<next step>" ...]
  does everything: writes checkpoint JSON (source of truth), syncs current-session.json,
  refreshes PROJECT_STATUS.md, regenerates TASK_LOG.md + SESSION_INDEX.md, then runs the
  validator. It does NOT populate context_for_next_agent - post-inject it (this file is the
  evidence) or it stays an empty string.

GOTCHAS
  - handoff-new.cjs always prints "validator: FAIL" in this environment: it shells out to
    python3/python and finds none. NOT a real failure. Re-run manually and it PASSes:
        python .agents/scripts/validate_handoff_state.py --platform cline
  - .agents/state/checkpoints/ is git-tracked and MUST exist. Deleting it makes handoff-new.cjs
    die with ENOENT. Restore with: git checkout -- .agents/state/checkpoints
  - .agents/state/task.md still exists on disk but is now referenced ONLY as "retired" (grep
    finds it in 6 files, every hit is a warning). Left in place deliberately - deleting it was
    offered and not chosen. Do not resurrect it.
  - .agents/handoff.md (dated 2026-07-28, by Qoder) is a STALE standalone handoff describing
    production-rollout steps for PR #161/#163/#165. It sits at the .agents/ root and is not
    part of the v2 workflow. Its name collides conceptually with workflows/handoff-to-any.md.
    Out of scope here - flagged, not touched.
  - Shell is PowerShell: '||', '2>nul', $vars and nested quotes misbehave; use .bat wrappers
    or single-quoted args.
